def compute(vars):
    gross_profit_2018 = vars["v1"]
    gross_profit_2019 = vars["v2"]
    operating_expenses_2018 = -vars["v3"]
    operating_expenses_2019 = -vars["v4"]

    total_2018 = gross_profit_2018 + operating_expenses_2018
    total_2019 = gross_profit_2019 + operating_expenses_2019

    if total_2018 == 0:
        return None

    change_ratio = (total_2019 - total_2018) / total_2018
    value = change_ratio * 100

    return {
        "value": value,
        "trace": {
            "gross_profit_2018": gross_profit_2018,
            "gross_profit_2019": gross_profit_2019,
            "operating_expenses_2018": operating_expenses_2018,
            "operating_expenses_2019": operating_expenses_2019,
            "total_2018": total_2018,
            "total_2019": total_2019,
            "change_ratio": change_ratio,
            "output_meta": {
                "currency": "USD",
                "scale": "thousand",
                "unit": "percentage"
            }
        }
    }
